activity_summary: The specimen sheet lies on the cloth for a minute after the rent. Three hands are on it. Your own is not, and would look like hen-tracks beside them.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked, and did not write on the sheet.

entities.name: Michael Drayton
entities.context: Had brought it, and left it for the minute.

entities.name: the specimen sheet
entities.context: Mentioned in Three hands on one sheet
